title: Define shared animation kernel protocol
summary: Make the SemanticObject -> SemanticTransformation -> MotionPlan -> sampled frame -> renderer protocol explicit, typed, and renderer-neutral before adding more one-off animation behavior.

sourceRefs.summary: Semantic document/object identity model that should feed the animation protocol.
Existing semantic animation primitives and lifecycle concepts.
Current concrete MotionPlan vocabulary for equation transforms.
Current time/progress playback boundary for equation motion.
Public animation SDK surface that should remain compatible or receive intentional wrappers.
Headless/kernel boundary catalogue that should constrain renderer-neutral protocol placement.

verification: npm test -- tests/equation-motion-player.test.ts tests/kp-animation-sdk.test.ts tests/headless-kernel-boundaries.test.ts tests/semantic.test.ts
expectedLearning: A minimal typed protocol for mapping semantic state plus time into deterministic renderer-neutral sampled frames.
Which parts of the current public SDK are protocol-shaped versus equation-demo-specific.
allowedWork: Introduce renderer-neutral protocol types for semantic object refs, semantic transformation refs, motion plans, sampled frames, clocks, and renderer adapters.
Adapt current equation motion code to expose or consume the protocol without changing visible behavior.
Document protocol contracts close to the code and in Theseus source refs.
disallowedWork: Do not break existing public SDK imports without a compatibility adapter.
Do not port graph animations before the protocol has tests against the equation path.
Do not encode mathematical semantics inside visual tween/motif helpers.
